stories.headline: Russia and Ukraine agree a big prisoner swap, but no peace breakthrough
body: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war.
Two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi ended without a major breakthrough.
It was their first meeting in nine months.
stories.vc: Small steps keep hopes of a ceasefire, and lower energy prices, alive.

stories.headline: Saudi oil output nears pre-war levels, OPEC says
body: Saudi Arabia pumped 10.563 million barrels a day in October, up over 2 million from September.
It's the highest since the Iran war began in February.
Russia also raised output.
stories.vc: Higher supply could ease fuel prices and inflation.

stories.headline: Russia's ambassador to the US dies suddenly
body: Russia's ambassador to the US, Alexander Darchiev, died suddenly at 66, Moscow said.
He had been in the job for about a year and a half.
No further details were given.
stories.vc: A vacancy in Washington could slow Russia-US diplomacy.

stories.headline: Tens of thousands join Poland's nationalist Independence Day march
body: Tens of thousands joined a nationalist Independence Day march in Warsaw.
It came days after a Krakow shooting killed six people.
PM Donald Tusk called for restraint.
stories.vc: Political tension can unsettle investors in one of Europe's fastest-growing economies.

stories.headline: Moody's raises India's growth forecast to 7%
body: Moody's now expects India's economy to grow 7% this year.
It cites broad momentum and resilience to the energy shock.
But inflation and a weak monsoon remain risks.
stories.joke: Moody's is in a good mood.
stories.vc: Upgrades support foreign investor confidence in India.

stories.statLabel: of metro costs paid by Karnataka
stories.headline: Karnataka says it pays 84% of Bengaluru metro costs
body: Karnataka pays ₹65,291 crore of the ₹77,891 crore metro outlay; the Centre pays ₹12,600 crore.
Minister Krishna Byre Gowda wants more central funding.
PM Modi opens the Pink Line's elevated stretch on 13 November.
stories.joke: Bengaluru's metro: built mostly on Karnataka's tab.
stories.vc: Funding fights can slow future metro phases.

stories.headline: Gaurav Munjal steps down as Unacademy CEO
body: Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal is stepping down as CEO and becoming executive chairman.
It comes two months after upGrad bought Unacademy for just over $200 million.
Chief business officer Akhilendra Kumar takes over.
stories.joke: A new chapter, but not a new textbook.
stories.vc: Leadership changes are common after edtech consolidation.

stories.headline: Qualcomm India layoffs could hit over 1,000 jobs
body: More than 1,000 jobs in India could be at risk in Qualcomm's global cuts.
The chipmaker calls it a performance-focused reduction.
Notices were expected from November.
stories.vc: Tech layoffs at big global firms affect India's engineering job market.

stories.headline: Meta's longtime infrastructure head is stepping down
body: Santosh Janardhan, Meta's head of infrastructure, is stepping down.
Former Amazon executive Dave Brown will replace him.
Janardhan will advise on Meta Compute during the transition.
stories.vc: Who runs Meta's data centres matters as it spends heavily on AI.
